title: Memory Retention Experiment
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Step-through experiment in which learners read a story-based and a fact-based presentation of the same content, answer recall questions with both hidden, and compare what each format made memorable.

learningObjectives: Compare memory retention between story-based and fact-based presentations to understand why stories enhance memory.

keyQuestions: Compare memory retention between story-based and fact-based presentations to understand why stories enhance memory.
commonMisconceptions: Facts are always more memorable than stories.
assessmentOpportunities: Learner answers all three recall questions correctly.
Learner explains why the story-only detail was recallable even though the fact list omitted it.
